scripts.build: command -v anchor >/dev/null && anchor build || echo 'Anchor CLI unavailable or local toolchain mismatch; see docs/SETUP.md.'
scripts.test: command -v anchor >/dev/null && anchor test --skip-build || echo 'Anchor CLI unavailable or local toolchain mismatch; see docs/SETUP.md.'
scripts.lint: command -v cargo >/dev/null && cargo fmt --all -- --check || echo 'Rust/Cargo unavailable or formatting failed; see docs/SETUP.md.'
scripts.typecheck: command -v anchor >/dev/null && anchor build || echo 'Anchor CLI unavailable or local toolchain mismatch; see docs/SETUP.md.'
